video_title: Isaiah Stewart on Fatherhood, Farm Life and Memphis | The Sanctuary | The Sanctuary | Andscape

quotes.speaker: Isaiah Stewart
quotes.summary_phrase: Isaiah Stewart on his reputation as an enforcer and his competitive nature
quotes.excerpt: A lot of people judge me off of my perception as a basketball player and an enforcer.
quotes.quote: A lot of people judge me off of my perception as a basketball player and an enforcer. To me, I think of it as I'm going to war. I'm so competitive, that's just who I am.

quotes.speaker: Isaiah Stewart
quotes.summary_phrase: Isaiah Stewart on his offseason training and focus on game situations
quotes.excerpt: I'm playing out of a role. I either got to make a read the pass or attack.
quotes.quote: I'm playing out of a role. I either got to make a read the pass or attack the basket and get to the rim.

quotes.speaker: Isaiah Stewart
quotes.summary_phrase: Isaiah Stewart on his role as a young veteran for the Memphis Grizzlies
quotes.excerpt: I'm a young vet, I'm 25 and I'm going into my seventh year.
quotes.quote: I'm a young vet, I'm 25 and I'm going into my seventh year. He wants me to set an example and show the right ways for the younger guys there and keep it moving forward.

quotes.speaker: Isaiah Stewart
quotes.summary_phrase: Isaiah Stewart on the Memphis Grizzlies' frontcourt and his role
quotes.excerpt: I'm excited about the big fella Zach and his versatility, and you know I'm coming with the muscle.
quotes.quote: I'm excited about the big fella Zach and his versatility, and you know I'm coming with the muscle.

quotes.speaker: Robert Banuelos
quotes.summary_phrase: Robert Banuelos on meeting Isaiah Stewart and learning about his farming passion
quotes.excerpt: It was after Isaiah told me what his passion and his dream was about farming.

text_blocks.speaker: Robert Banuelos
text_blocks.text: It was after Isaiah told me what his passion and his dream was about farming. And he says, I want to get this to thrive and be the biggest farming in Deluz with a variety of fruit trees. And he says, can you help me? I'm down for the task, let's go.

text_blocks.speaker: Marc Spears
text_blocks.text: So when you met him, did you know who he was?

text_blocks.speaker: Robert Banuelos
text_blocks.text: At first, he never told me who he was when I was giving him a bid over the phone. Then I said, all right, so who do I make the invoice to? He said Isaiah Stewart. I go, Isaiah Stewart like the basketball player? And he goes, yeah. And I go, man, I'm good then.

quotes.speaker: Isaiah Stewart
quotes.summary_phrase: Isaiah Stewart on the emotional impact of being traded from the Detroit Pistons
quotes.excerpt: I was in a situation where you work so hard and you have a goal.
quotes.quote: I was in a situation where you work so hard and you have a goal and you're putting your all into something and you're not able to reap that kind of reward. It will make you question yourself, stress yourself out because you know the passion and love you have for the game. Me and my wife were just talking and we both felt that this may be our last season here in Detroit.

quotes.speaker: Isaiah Stewart
quotes.summary_phrase: Isaiah Stewart on his reaction to being traded to the Memphis Grizzlies
quotes.excerpt: I got a call from my agent. He's thinking it's maybe the Wizards or the Lakers.
quotes.quote: I got a call from my agent. He's thinking it's maybe the Wizards or the Lakers, and call me back a couple minutes later and said, Trajan called, he got a deal from Memphis that he can't turn down. So a few minutes later it came out I got traded to Memphis.

quotes.speaker: Isaiah Stewart
quotes.summary_phrase: Isaiah Stewart on his appreciation for the Memphis Grizzlies' fan base
quotes.excerpt: I'm thankful because I'm somewhere where I'm really wanted and the fan base already respects and loves me.
quotes.quote: I'm thankful because I'm somewhere where I'm really wanted and the fan base already respects and loves me. I'd rather be where I'm wanted and headed back into a situation where it's not the best.

quotes.speaker: Isaiah Stewart
quotes.summary_phrase: Isaiah Stewart on his genuine love for the city of Detroit
quotes.excerpt: I got so much love for the city of Detroit, genuine love.
quotes.quote: I got so much love for the city of Detroit, genuine love. They welcomed me with open arms and I'm a 19-year-old in the locker room full of grown men and holding my own space, creating an identity and bringing toughness back every day in practice and it's something that I helped build.

quotes.speaker: Isaiah Stewart
quotes.summary_phrase: Isaiah Stewart on his excitement for the Memphis Grizzlies' rebuilding process
quotes.excerpt: I'm excited, it's a great opportunity and there's a lot of hungry young guys over there.
quotes.quote: I'm excited, it's a great opportunity and there's a lot of hungry young guys over there. I look forward to just doing everything I can to help this rebuild and let's do it.

quotes.speaker: Isaiah Stewart
quotes.summary_phrase: Isaiah Stewart on his reputation as the toughest player in the NBA
quotes.excerpt: It doesn't matter to me if someone thinks I'm tough or not, I'm just a no-nonsense guy.
quotes.quote: It doesn't matter to me if someone thinks I'm tough or not, I'm just a no-nonsense guy. I just want to go and do my job. The style of basketball I play is just the way I play.

quotes.speaker: Isaiah Stewart
quotes.summary_phrase: Isaiah Stewart on managing his emotions and intensity on the court
quotes.excerpt: Sometimes I go to sleep the night before a game, calm myself down because you get so hyped.
quotes.quote: Sometimes I go to sleep the night before a game, calm myself down because you get so hyped up. To me, I think of it as I'm going to war. When you have that adrenaline rushing and you have that energy and that passion, you don't want it to get too much, so you got to keep reminding yourself it's good, but keep it at a certain level.

quotes.speaker: Isaiah Stewart
quotes.summary_phrase: Isaiah Stewart on his lack of regrets regarding past on-court incidents
quotes.excerpt: I don't have no regrets. I feel like there's lessons out of everything.
quotes.quote: I don't have no regrets. I feel like there's lessons out of everything. Even going back to that first incident, Charlotte, I don't have no regrets. I don't care what people may perceive me as. I come to play basketball and I play the game a certain way.
